2607.14896.title: StructureClaw: Traceable LLM Agents and an Executable Benchmark for Structural Engineering Workflows
2607.14896.paper_summary: Addressing a structural-engineering request requires more than a single answer; it requires a chain of interdependent artifacts: interpreted requirements, a computable model, validation records, solver outputs, code-check records, and a final report. Evaluations centered on question answering or script generation rarely verify this complete evidence chain and may therefore reward fluent outputs even when the underlying engineering workflow is incomplete, internally inconsistent, or non-executable. To address this limitation, we present StructureClaw, an artifact-centered workbench in which LLM agents operate through governed engineering skills, typed tools, shared artifact state, and local analysis backends. We also introduce StructureClaw-Bench, an executable benchmark of 150 controlled scenarios spanning standard workflow execution, interactive robustness, and multimodal structural-model reconstruction. A scenario succeeds only when all required artifact- and execution-level assertions pass in a single run. Across ten agent-model configurations, each evaluated on the same 50 standard cases, the average Success Rate rises from 56.8% with the generic-skill baseline to 88.6% with the full automatic workflow. The interactive and multimodal evaluations identify two prominent remaining challenges: safe handling of invalid numerical inputs and fixture-consistent reconstruction of structural models. These findings show that artifact-centered evaluation can expose workflow-level failures that are difficult to identify from final responses alone, providing a more rigorous basis for evaluating and improving structural-engineering agents. The code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/structureclaw/structureclaw.
2607.14896.paper_summary_zh: 解決結構工程請求不僅需要單一答案；它需要一系列相互依賴的工件：解釋過的需求、可計算的模型、驗證記錄、求解器輸出、代碼檢查記錄和最終報告。以問題回答或腳本生成為中心的評估很少能驗證這整個證據鏈，因此即使基礎工程工作流程不完整、內部不一致或不可執行，仍可能獲得流暢的輸出。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了 StructureClaw，一個以工件為中心的工作台，在這裡 LLM 代理通過受控的工程技能、類型化工具、共享工件狀態和本地分析後端進行操作。我們還介紹了 StructureClaw-Bench，這是一個可執行的基準，涵蓋 150 個受控場景，涉及標準工作流程執行、互動穩健性和多模態結構模型重建。只有當所有所需的工件和執行級別的斷言在一次運行中通過時，場景才算成功。在十個代理模型配置中，每個配置在相同的 50 個標準案例上進行評估，平均成功率從通用技能基線的 56.8% 上升到全自動工作流程的 88.6%。互動和多模態評估確定了兩個突出的剩餘挑戰：安全處理無效數值輸入和固定件一致的結構模型重建。這些發現顯示，以工件為中心的評估可以揭示難以僅從最終回應中識別的工作流程級別失敗，為評估和改進結構工程代理提供了更嚴謹的基礎。代碼和基準可在 https://github.com/structureclaw/structureclaw 獲得。
